title: Clawback Amounts from Productivity and Innovation Credit Payouts
what_it_is: Clawback Amounts from Productivity and Innovation Credit Payouts

sections.label: IRAS PIC claims audits
sections.summary: IRAS investigated or audited about 71,000 PIC Cash Payout claims from Years of Assessment 2011 to 2015, clawing back $11 million for 2011 to 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Relying on the experiences of IRAS investigators and advanced analytics, IRAS has investigated or audited about 71,000 claims, or around 30% of the PIC Cash Payout claims made from Years of Assessment 2011 to 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: One thousand five hundred of these claims investigated or audited required clawback.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As for the amount of cash payout clawed back, for Years of Assessment 2011 to 2014, IRAS has clawed back $11 million, of which, $8 million has been recovered to date.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Taking the Year of Assessment 2014 for illustration, out of the 10,000 claims investigated or audited, IRAS has clawed back $7 million worth of improper claims from 500 cases, of which $5 million have been recovered to date.

sections.label: Rejected and clawed back claims
sections.summary: About 43,000 claims were investigated or audited and rejected upfront, while about 1,470 cases led to actual clawback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: After they have been investigated or audited and rejected upfront, it is about 43,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: There are a number of investigated and audited cases that led to actual clawback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: That is about 1,470 or if we round it up, 1,500.

sections.label: Remaining claims under review
sections.summary: Deducting 43,000 rejected claims and 1,470 clawed back from 71,000 leaves approximately 25,000 cases still being looked at.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: Based on the figures she cited earlier, the 71,000 being investigated, after we deduct the 43,000 where the claims were rejected prior to payout, and the 1,470 where they were clawed back after payout, does this mean that there were more than 26,000 cases where payout has been made, but clawback has not been achieved, as yet?

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I think the Member took the 71,000, minus off the 43,000, minus off 1,500, and that gives a figure of approximately 25,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, they are in the process of being looked at.
